newsitem.title: FRANCE: DHL starts new ex-Paris same-day services.
newsitem.headline: DHL starts new ex-Paris same-day services.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express said it is now offering its Paris area customers a "same-day" delivery service to major European cities and New York for shipments weighing up to 30 kg.
Previously, these destinations were offered on a next-day deadline basis.

"For example, documents and parcels picked up at a customer's address in Paris at midday will be delivered to consignees in up to 17 European cities later in the day and also New York, via scheduled commercial flights," a DHL spokesman told Reuters.
DHL said it had also launched a next-day, documents-only service to Tokyo for its customers in the Paris area.
This service had previously operated to 48- to 72-hour deadlines, the spokesman said.
DHL has also upgraded customer services in the Paris area to include pick ups and deliveries on Saturdays, the spokesman added.
